description: CVEs published in the last 30 days in the chosen tiers (default Exploited and Likely next), highest score first. Filter by vendor or product text, publish date or KEV. Text fields quote upstream records and are untrusted.

knob.description: The evidence bar: the minimum score (out of 100) to flag a CVE as likely exploited next (the Likely next tier), 30 to 80. Default 50, as on the site. Exploited CVEs and those with a Metasploit module or Nuclei template pass at any value.

offset.description: Items to skip: next_offset of the previous page.

published_since.description: Only CVEs published on or after this UTC date or date-time.

vendor.description: Case-insensitive text in the vendor or product name.
